cliApiToken.description: Shared secret for CLI authentication. Auto-generated if not set. ENV: CLI_API_TOKEN

apiUrl.description: Hub URL for CLI connections. ENV: HAPI_API_URL

extraHeaders.description: Extra headers for CLI to hub HTTP and WebSocket requests. ENV: HAPI_EXTRA_HEADERS_JSON

listenHost.description: Hub HTTP bind address. ENV: HAPI_LISTEN_HOST

publicUrl.description: Public URL for external access (e.g., Telegram Mini App). ENV: HAPI_PUBLIC_URL

telegramBotToken.description: Telegram Bot API token from @BotFather. ENV: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN

serverChanSendKey.description: ServerChan SendKey for WeChat push notifications. ENV: SERVERCHAN_SENDKEY

serverChanBackgroundOnly.description: Only send ServerChan notifications when no visible HAPI connection exists in the namespace. ENV: SERVERCHAN_BACKGROUND_ONLY

relayAuthKey.description: Per-hub relay auth key issued by the relay server. Auto-obtained if not set. ENV: HAPI_RELAY_AUTH

vapidKeys.description: Auto-generated Web Push VAPID keys. Do not edit manually.

machineId.description: Auto-generated unique machine identifier. Do not edit manually.

machineIdConfirmedByServer.description: Internal flag. Do not edit manually.

runnerAutoStartWhenRunningHappy.description: Auto-start runner when running hapi command.

directoryAuthProfiles.description: Runner-local Claude credentials bound to a directory tree. Sessions this runner spawns at or below pathPrefix authenticate with that token instead of the host's ambient login. Longest matching prefix wins, and matching is segment-aware so /x/proj-old does not match /x/proj. An explicit per-spawn token from the app still takes precedence.

pathPrefix.description: Absolute path prefix; a leading ~ is expanded to the current user's home.

claudeCodeOAuthToken.description: Claude Code OAuth token for sessions under pathPrefix. Injected as CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.

providerCredentials.description: Hub-managed voice and dictation provider credentials; process environment variables win over settings-backed values.
